description: OpenAI client call through OpenRouter, one chat turn, traced by OpenLLMetry.
notes: TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on the span. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false. The client keeps the real base URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, and the harness routes the request to the capture mock under that host (D-IN-3). OpenLLMetry writes gen_ai.provider.name openrouter itself, so the provider is openrouter without the endpoint rule. OpenLLMetry strips openai/ from both the request and the response model, so the span is priced by the publisher rows for the bare name gpt-4o-mini (D-IN-13). This case pins that gateway pricing, not the endpoint rule. Cost is computed, not reported. Token counts are input 14 and output 8.
